establishes: Hungry Snorlax is its own named card with distinct card text and illustration
the first promotional distribution began on 1997-12-10
the 1999 CD distribution was a reprint of the same card
doesNotEstablish: a physical distinction between the two distributions

ownerDecision.statement: Hungry Snorlax is its own artwork and was not printed as another card release. The later promotional reprint is not distinguishable, so no second collector entry is needed.

decision.collectorEntryPolicy: one indistinguishable printing across both documented distribution events
decision.basis: The pinned Bulbapedia card article identifies one Hungry Snorlax card with its own name, illustrator and attacks, dates its first distribution to December 10, 1997, and calls the 1999 CD copy a reprint. The collection owner confirms that the reprint is not physically distinguishable and therefore remains the same collector entry.
